header:
Thanksgiving gas
is racing a record

lines.text: Gas just fell 50 cents. Thanksgiving could still set a record.
lines.say: Gas just fell fifty cents. Thanksgiving could still set a record.

lines.text: AAA's national average slid from about $4.23 on October 29 to $3.72 on Thursday.
lines.say: AAA's national average slid from about four twenty-three on October twenty-ninth to three seventy-two on Thursday.

lines.text: CNN's look at AAA data says that 50.5-cent drop is the biggest three-week slide since 2008.
lines.say: CNN's look at AAA data says that fifty-and-a-half-cent drop is the biggest three-week slide since two thousand eight.

lines.text: The catch: AAA's Thanksgiving Day record is $3.58, from 2022, and Friday was $3.69.
lines.say: The catch: AAA's Thanksgiving Day record is three fifty-eight, from twenty twenty-two, and Friday was three sixty-nine.

lines.text: AAA says another 15-cent drop by Thanksgiving would dodge it. GasBuddy forecasts $3.62, which would be a record.
lines.say: AAA says another fifteen-cent drop by Thanksgiving would dodge it. GasBuddy forecasts three sixty-two, which would be a record.

lines.text: Still, $3.72 is 63 cents more than a year ago, when gas was $3.09.
lines.say: Still, three seventy-two is sixty-three cents more than a year ago, when gas was three oh nine.

lines.text: On a 15-gallon tank, that's $55.80 now versus $46.35 last year, by our math.
lines.say: On a fifteen-gallon tank, that's fifty-five eighty now versus forty-six thirty-five last year, by our math.

lines.text: So for the nearly 73 million people driving this Thanksgiving, falling fast still isn't cheap.
lines.say: So for the nearly seventy-three million people driving this Thanksgiving, falling fast still isn't cheap.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Gas Fell 50 Cents, but Thanksgiving Could Still Set a Record
post.ig:
Gas just fell about 50 cents, and Thanksgiving could still set a price record.
AAA's national average fell from about $4.23 on Oct 29 to $3.72 on Nov 19, which CNN's analysis of AAA data calls the biggest 3-week drop since 2008.
AAA's Thanksgiving Day record is $3.58 (2022). Friday's average: $3.69.
AAA says another ~15-cent drop by Thanksgiving would avoid a record; GasBuddy forecasts $3.62, which would be a record. These are their forecasts, not ours.
Gas is still 63 cents above last year's $3.09.
Sources: AAA, CNN, GasBuddy.
News and education, not financial advice.
